maddeler.e:
استطلن (form X)
# اِسْتَطَلْنَ (istaṭalna) /is.ta.tˤal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَطَالَ (istaṭāla)
# اُسْتُطِلْنَ (ustuṭilna) /us.tu.tˤil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَطَالَ (istaṭāla)
# اِسْتَطِلْنَ (istaṭilna) /is.ta.tˤil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَطَالَ (istaṭāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
